ru.name: Тайный клинок

tooltip: Защита от атак спереди во время замаха

en.description: Prerequisite: Use the [Secret Book] Abyssal Legacy ([The Magnus] Abyssal Revelation quest reward) Invoke your jutsu to create a kunai, then hurl it out, sending a ripple of pain and chaos through your foes.
en.command: {KeyBind:Kick} Hold {KeyBind:Kick} on hits for chasing maneuvers {KeyBind:Kick} after certain skills to perform instantly Can be added to a Quick Slot Can be used via a Quick Slot with your sah chakram Throwing Kick only available via a Quick Slot after learning this skill
